summary: Kiggans voted for H.R. 8034, providing over $26 billion in military aid to Israel, and co-sponsored H. Res. 1117 opposing one-sided pressure on Israel with respect to Gaza. She also voted Yea on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, which directs use of the IHRA definition in Title VI education-discrimination enforcement, though the vote does not establish her rationale. These actions reflect an unqualified defense of Israel's military and political position.
